edits.before:
write(unit=this%file_unit, fmt='(a)') 'set term ' // gnuplot_term_type // &
            ' size ' // gnuplot_term_size // ' enhanced font "' // &
            gnuplot_term_font // '"' // &
            ' title "' // md_name // ': ' // md_rev //'"'   ! library name and version
edits.after: write(unit=this%file_unit, fmt='(a)') 'set term pngcairo size 800,600 enhanced font "DejaVu Sans,11"'

scope: The checked example computes a Gaussian grid and uses the upstream contour interface to generate a PNG. A checksum-guarded catalog patch selects the headless pngcairo terminal instead of the upstream window terminal; the numerical and plotting procedures are unchanged. GNUplot is pinned as a native build dependency. The sandbox must return a browser-viewable PNG, and its preview is reviewed. MIT licensing is stated in both LICENSE and the upstream FPM manifest. Q covers graphics.
initial_consumer_findings: An initial consumer mixed an incremental contour-level option with the contour routine's own automatic-level setting and returned a blank plot. The checked consumer leaves contour level selection to the library; the returned PNG was inspected and shows concentric Gaussian contours.
The only source patch replaces the window-terminal header with pngcairo for headless execution; it is checksum-guarded and included in local project exports.
